text:
noah: heads-up — i'll kick off a 10% canary for bluejay-v2-int4 at :15. want to lock the gate rules before i flip traffic. here's my proposal:

noah: gate goals:
- quality composite: pass if (all critical_slices pass) AND (macro_delta_f1 <= 1.2%)
- safety slices (toxicity, pii, hallucination_longdoc): each must be binary pass (1)
- latency: p95_weighted <= +10% and p99_weighted <= +18%
- error rate (5xx) <= baseline + 0.2% absolute

emma: prefer p95 over p99 for normal rolling, but keep p99 for escalation. i like the composite quality idea. add a "soft-float" grace window: allow one 120s transient breach for non-safety signals

devon: can we make the composite metric a tiny weighted score instead of strict AND? critical_slices=weight0.7, macro_f1=0.3 and require score >= 0.88. gives smoother decisions for borderline cases

mira: i've seen weighted scoring hide safety regressions. keep safety slices strict equals 1. for other slices devon's score makes sense. also add a long-doc hallucination metric: fuzzy_rouge >= 0.7 for top1 answers

noah: suggestion: rollout policy tiers:
- tier0 (monitor): emit per-slice pass/fail, diffs, and top-answer hashes to /metrics/canary/*
- tier1 (hold): transient breach -> pause ramp, send alert to #eng-oncall, keep 10% for manual review
- tier2 (auto-fallback): sustained composite score < threshold for 5m or safety fail -> rollback

emma: ops-bot: will the canary publish per-slice rolling windows and the weighted p95/p99?

ops-bot: ops-bot: scheduled canary: start=1729500090 for model=bluejay-v2-int4 target=10%. metrics: canary.slice.<name>.pass (0/1), canary.composite_score, canary.weighted_p95_ms, canary.weighted_p99_ms, canary.error_rate_pct

devon: add quiet-burn shadow for 48h collecting diffs against prod baseline (no traffic shift) — helps catch late regression on rare slices

mira: i'll wire a fuzzy-match check for longdoc answers and post samples to this thread if i see >1 weird case in 30m

noah: rollout policy YAML (draft):
```yaml
rollout:
  target: 10%
  composite:
    weights:
      critical_slices: 0.7
      macro_f1: 0.3
    threshold: 0.88
  safety_checks:
    - slice: toxicity
      required: 1
    - slice: pii
      required: 1
    - slice: hallucination_longdoc
      required: 1
  latency:
    p95_weighted_pct: 10
    p99_weighted_pct: 18
  error_rate_delta_abs: 0.2
  transient_grace_seconds: 120
  sustained_failure_seconds: 300
  quiet_burn_hours: 48
```

emma: i'll attach the alert playbook and add a dashboard link in the rollout ticket. tagging @eng-oncall to review thresholds

devon: if we see repeated borderline fails, plan auto-shadow-swap to a cpu-quantized fallback for a quieter comparison

noah: thanks all — starting in ~2m. will post first 10min summary here. :rocket:
